description: On the bed in front of you are toy sandwich pieces: a green plate, two bun halves, lettuce, a pink meat slice, onion rings, cucumber slices, a tomato slice, and a strip of bacon. The left hand slides a bun half onto the green plate and adds the lettuce, then the right hand places an onion ring, sets a tomato slice on top, lays the bacon across, and both hands stack on the pink meat and cucumber slices before the right hand brings the top bun down to close the sandwich.
